claim_scope: Finite empirical moment objective on a bounded row subset. The original-moment family is the global optimum of its fixed matrix; the rotation-invariant family is a nonconvex objective solved by iterative Stiefel descent and is at best locally optimal. Rotation invariance is exact by construction and is NOT a privacy guarantee.
